name: @aws-sdk/client-cognito-identity-provider
description: AWS SDK for JavaScript Cognito Identity Provider Client for Node.js, Browser and React Native

readme.summary: Generic AWS SDK v3 monorepo README that explains the overall SDK well but never addresses the specific Cognito Identity Provider client.
readme.top_issue: README is not specific to @aws-sdk/client-cognito-identity-provider — all examples use DynamoDB, with no Cognito-specific usage, configuration (auth flows, user pools, etc.), or troubleshooting guidance.
